name: model-picker
description: Helps Claude pick the right Claude model and effort level for the work, from Haiku 5.5 to Fable 5.2. One skill that matches a task to a model and effort based on the stakes, the kind of work and how you pay, with the published evidence behind each pick. Includes ready-made agent files for Claude Code and a way to verify which model each agent really ran on. Updated when Anthropic releases or changes a model.
